add.item: Sony FE 14mm f/1.8 GM or FE 20mm f/1.8 G
add.why: About 1⅓ stops faster than f/2.8: half the ISO, or shorter exposures and rounder stars, on a faint night subject.
Coastal and desert nights dew the front element within an hour; a heater keeps the whole session sharp.
